text:
marco: heads-up, starting QuartzPay LoRA onboarding. pushed quick-eval to staging (job 6019). customer traffic is invoices-heavy with parentheses, signs, and mixed currency symbols — expect odd token splits.
tess: plan: fp16 -> int8 -> int4. we'll capture QA_F1, exact_match, amount_precision (new tiny metric), and avg_latency. ETA ~2h.
nora: uploaded focused probe set /evals/quartzpay/invoice-cases-v1.json (45 examples) covering commas, parentheses, negative amounts, EUR/JPY symbols. flagged on the job.
liam: fp16 baseline local: QA_F1=0.863, exact_match=0.71, amount_precision=0.98, avg_latency=68ms @batch=1. snippet: ```json
{"job":"6019","phase":"fp16","metrics":{"qa_f1":0.863,"exact_match":0.71,"amount_precision":0.98,"avg_latency_ms":68}}
```
tess: int8 on staging: QA_F1=0.856, exact_match=0.69, amount_precision=0.94, avg_latency=54ms. main failure: thousand separators and spacing around parentheses.
nora: example fail to inspect: source has "Inv total (EUR): (3,200)" -> model returned "(3200)" (no comma, no space), checker marked as mismatch.
marco: two options: (A) scoring canonicalizer that normalizes numeric punctuation only for eval/scoring (low-risk) or (B) a decoder-side bias table tweak for int4 to prefer the comma-token emission (higher risk, kernel-level). prefer A for canary.
liam: I ran a token-id diff tool: `tools/tokenmap --model quartzpay --quant int4 --sample 12` -> shows comma and paren tokens collapsed into adjacent token id in int4 decode path. saving output to local.
ci-bot: deploy info: staging job 6019 -> int4 run queued on node gpu-dedicated-4 (ETA 10m).
tess: decision leaning: use scoring canonicalizer + gating on amount_precision for canary promotion, keep int4 disabled until we have decode traces.
nora: pushed PR #2134 with scoring normalizer (regex canonicalize thousands and consistent spacing around parentheses). normalizer only affects scoring comparator, not emitted text. example (one-liner): `text = re.sub(r"(?<=\\d)[,](?=\\d)", "", text); text = re.sub(r"\\(\\s+", "(", text)`
liam: reran quickpack with canonicalizer: int8 amount_precision=0.975, probe_fail=3/45. int4 amount_precision=0.91, probe_fail=7/45. token-id dumps for failing int4 cases uploaded to s3://redwood-debug/quartzpay/6019/int4-tokenids.log
marco: OK final: int8 as canary, int4 off by default. owners: tess->quant & canary runs, nora->probe curation + PR, liam->token diffs & logs. I'll write rollout note and include rollback step (pin model to fp16). :memo:
tess: added CI alert: if amount_precision dips >1% vs baseline on probe set we auto-notify and block promotion.
nora: small docs ask: add line in release notes clarifying "scoring canonicalizer only; model outputs unchanged" so PM/legal don't confuse it with model-editing.
marco: wrapping up — check status in 6h, will re-open if token-diff artifacts show systematic decoder rounding. thanks team :thumbsup:
